description: This file defines the PhotoView class, a custom Android ImageView subclass that extends the standard ImageView with additional features for downloading, caching, and displaying images from URLs, particularly optimized for Picasa images. It manages image download threads, view visibility, and resource handling.

classes.name: PhotoView
classes.description: A custom ImageView that fetches images from URLs, with support for caching, download management, and view visibility control.

methods.name: clearImage
methods.description: Clears the image from the view and makes it visible.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the current image.

methods.name: setImageURL
methods.description: Sets the image URL, manages download threads, and optionally updates the displayed drawable.

methods.name: setStatusDrawable
methods.description: Sets a Drawable as the current content if the view was empty.

methods.name: setStatusResource
methods.description: Sets a resource drawable as the current content if the view was empty.
